title: Getting a running rest back after a watch restart or app update is never tested
what: When the watch restarts, the app updates or Alarms & reminders is switched on, the watch rebuilds a saved rest: alarm, countdown card, copy settings, version for the phone. No test runs this. No watch test touches the restart or the rest restore at all.
expected: A test restarts with a rest saved, with none, with one already ended and with one skipped, and checks one buzz at the right time and no buzz for a lost rest.
fix_line: Add watch tests that run the restart path with a saved rest

title: How the watch takes in what the phone sends is never tested
what: The watch's handling of each phone item (save a rest, set its alarm, show the card, drop an old or unreadable item, clear on skip or discard, keep the gym colour) has no test. Watch tests only check small helpers, like the 5-second buzz rule.
expected: Tests feed the watch phone items, including late, repeated and broken ones, and check the saved rest, the alarm and the buzz.
fix_line: Add watch tests that feed phone items into the watch's state and check the result

title: The Done, +15 s and Skip buttons on the watch's rest card are never tested
what: No test presses Done, +15 s or Skip on the watch's rest card, or checks that the phone ends or lengthens the rest or ticks the right set. 'Phone not reachable' is never checked either. One test only reads the code to see that the phone's refusal reaches the watch.
expected: A test presses each button and checks what the phone receives, and checks the words when the phone cannot be reached.
fix_line: Add tests for the three rest card buttons and the no-phone words

title: The watch's own rest notifications and buzz pattern are never tested
what: No test checks the watch's countdown card, its Rest is over card (words, no button, going away by itself, only one at a time), the long-pause-short buzz, or that Ring through Do Not Disturb really gets through. One test only reads the code to see that the buzz is always called.
expected: Tests check each card's words and lifetime and the buzz pattern; Do Not Disturb is checked once on a real watch before release.
fix_line: Add watch tests for both cards and the buzz, plus a Do Not Disturb check on a real watch

title: The watch's memory of its copy settings is never tested
what: The watch remembers the copy settings it applied, so it only sets them again when they change, after a refusal, or after an update from the older name. No test runs this. Tests only check which tags are chosen.
expected: A test applies the settings twice, makes the watch refuse once, and starts from the older name, and checks when they are set again.
fix_line: Add a watch test for when the copy settings are set again

title: HQ's view of a member's watch screen log is never tested
what: Tests check how the phone builds and sends the watch log. Nothing checks how HQ shows it: the log under its message, no empty block when there is none, each message keeping its own log, or that a gym's owner and staff can never read it.
expected: A test sends two messages with a log and one without, then checks what HQ shows and that the gym's side cannot see them.
fix_line: Add an HQ test that shows feedback messages with and without the watch log

title: The heart sensor starting and stopping on the watch is never tested
what: Tests check the heart line's words (dash, number, hidden). Nothing checks that the sensor stops when the screen dims or the workout ends, that the question is not asked again, or that the logging screen shows the same number as the rest timer.
expected: Tests check the sensor turns on and off with the workout and the dim, and that both screens show one reading.
fix_line: Add watch tests for when the heart sensor starts and stops
